title: No difference between `Discrete` and `Capture` blend modes in `BlendSpace2D`
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1]
v4.6.dev.mono.custom_build [f50d7fa1e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev.mono (f50d7fa1e) - Windows 11 (build 22621) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9820X CPU @ 3.30GHz (20 threads) - 127.6 GiB memory

### Issue description

The documentation says that the `Capture` mode starts the new animation at the last animation's playback position. So, logically, the `Discrete` mode should start the new animation from the beginning. However, I don't see any difference between these modes. Both modes work like the `Capture` mode.

Additionally, the `Capture` mode produces errors when animation is switched for the first time:
```
E 0:00:03:470   AnimationNode::set_parameter: Condition "!process_state->tree->property_parent_map.has(node_state.base_path)" is true.
  <C++ Source>  scene\animation\animation_tree.cpp:91 @ AnimationNode::set_parameter()
```
Additional error information:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/79860#issuecomment-2889728014
https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/1nkryn2/animation_tree_error_set_parameter/
https://forum.godotengine.org/t/possible-permanence-of-issue-104018/106174/3

### Steps to reproduce

You can use the attached MRP. This project implements animations for four directions. Each direction has its own animation, consisting of five frames. You can switch between animations using arrow keys. The video demonstrates that switching animations works the same in both blend modes.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/55611ef2-b43d-4139-9619-fa2d78c00969

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[BlendSpace2d.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23031731/BlendSpace2d.zip)
